source: BPHS Dhana Yoga 2nd and 11th Lords, paraphrased
effect: 2nd lord aur 11th house ka sambandh utkrisht Dhana Yoga banata hai, jisse aakasmik aur sthayi dhan labh hota hai.
Guru ka dhan (2nd) ya labh (11th) sthan me hona safe wealth accumulation aur ethical wealth deta hai.
Labhesh ka shubh sthano me hona multiple income streams aur investment gains ka yog banata hai.

source: Venus in 2nd or 11th Wealth of luxuries, paraphrased
effect: Shukra 2nd ya 11th me luxurious lifestyle, physical assets aur vehicle/property blessings deta hai.
Dhanesh 12th me hone par saving strategies par dhyan dena zaroori hai; foreign spendings ya charity me dhan kharch hota hai.

source: Running Dasha of 2nd or 11th Lord, paraphrased
effect: 2nd ya 11th house ke lord ki Mahadasha aarthik unnati aur purane loans chukane ka shreshth samay hota hai.
Rahu 11th house me unexpected ya windfall financial gains aur networking network se labh dilata hai.
Shani 2nd me shuruwat me savings me slow progress deta hai par samay ke sath disciplined wealth create karta hai.

source: Mercury in 2nd Commercial Speech & Wealth, paraphrased
effect: Budha 2nd me commercial brilliance, trading skills aur sweet financial intellect pradan karta hai.

source: Moon-Jupiter Gaja Kesari in Wealth Axis, paraphrased
effect: Gajakesari yoga se aarthik samriddhi, samman aur sthayi sampatti ka labh milta hai.
